text_block_list.text:
It's Голд Сити's second summer camp.
This time
last year, she was feeling
tense, but now...

Hey, can I go straight to the beach after
I leave
my stuff?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I'm really itching to go for a run.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'll be up against two insanely fast
runners in the
Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it. I want to
become
stronger and win.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Just talking about it is giving me a
serious urge to
run. Let's go, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It looks like this summer camp is off to a
blazing
hot start!
